body:
## What it does

Made for people whose ADHD, anxiety or low mood turns ordinary upkeep into a wall. It checks in kindly rather than nagging, rolls up its sleeves on the tasks you are stuck on, and carries light recurring reminders such as meals, prescriptions and a friend's birthday. Support, not diagnosis. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @TheDevilCloud shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
